jobs_claim_ck.name: jobs_claim_ck
jobs_claim_ck.value: (((claim_expires_at IS NOT NULL) = (state = 'claimed'::text)) AND ((claimed_by IS NOT NULL) = (state = 'claimed'::text)))

overrides_by_kind_ck.name: overrides_by_kind_ck
overrides_by_kind_ck.value:
CASE kind
    WHEN 'gate'::text THEN ((gate_evaluation_id IS NOT NULL) AND (commit_sha IS NOT NULL) AND (gate = ANY (ARRAY[3, 4])) AND (dispatch_id IS NULL) AND (action IS NULL))
    WHEN 'dispatch'::text THEN ((dispatch_id IS NOT NULL) AND (action IS NOT NULL) AND (gate IS NULL) AND (gate_evaluation_id IS NULL) AND (commit_sha IS NULL))
    ELSE NULL::boolean
END

device_logins_approved_ck.name: device_logins_approved_ck
device_logins_approved_ck.value: ((state <> ALL (ARRAY['approved'::text, 'consumed'::text])) OR ((approved_by IS NOT NULL) AND (approved_at IS NOT NULL)))

checkpoints_approved_ck.name: checkpoints_approved_ck
checkpoints_approved_ck.value: ((state <> 'approved'::text) OR ((approved_at IS NOT NULL) AND (approved_by IS NOT NULL)))

facts_source_repo_ck.name: facts_source_repo_ck
facts_source_repo_ck.value: ((source <> 'repo'::text) OR ((repo_commit IS NOT NULL) AND (repo_path IS NOT NULL)))

facts_span_ck.name: facts_span_ck
facts_span_ck.value: (((span_start IS NULL) = (span_end IS NULL)) AND ((span_start IS NULL) OR (message_id IS NOT NULL)))

plans_source_onboarding_ck.name: plans_source_onboarding_ck
plans_source_onboarding_ck.value: ((source <> 'onboarding'::text) OR ((session_id IS NOT NULL) AND (proposal_id IS NULL)))

plans_source_proposal_ck.name: plans_source_proposal_ck
plans_source_proposal_ck.value: ((source <> 'proposal'::text) OR ((proposal_id IS NOT NULL) AND (session_id IS NULL)))

plans_approved_ck.name: plans_approved_ck
plans_approved_ck.value:
CASE
    WHEN (state = 'draft'::text) THEN ((approved_at IS NULL) AND (approved_by IS NULL))
    ELSE ((approved_at IS NOT NULL) AND (approved_by IS NOT NULL))
END

dispatches_parked_ck.name: dispatches_parked_ck
dispatches_parked_ck.value: (((state = 'parked'::text) = (parked_from IS NOT NULL)) AND ((parked_from IS NULL) OR (parked_from <> 'parked'::text)))

findings_cites_ck.name: findings_cites_ck
findings_cites_ck.value: (((target_ref IS NOT NULL) AND (evidence IS NOT NULL)) OR (state = ANY (ARRAY['triage'::text, 'dismissed'::text])))

findings_decided_by_ck.name: findings_decided_by_ck
findings_decided_by_ck.value:
CASE decided_by_kind
    WHEN 'user'::text THEN ((decided_by_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (decided_by_attempt_id IS NULL) AND (fixed_by_check IS NULL))
    WHEN 'agent'::text THEN ((decided_by_user_id IS NULL) AND (decided_by_attempt_id IS NOT NULL) AND (fixed_by_check IS NULL))
    WHEN 'check'::text THEN ((decided_by_user_id IS NULL) AND (decided_by_attempt_id IS NULL) AND (fixed_by_check IS NOT NULL))
    ELSE ((decided_by_user_id IS NULL) AND (decided_by_attempt_id IS NULL) AND (fixed_by_check IS NULL))
END

missions_started_factory_commit_ck.name: missions_started_factory_commit_ck
missions_started_factory_commit_ck.value: ((onboarding_started_at IS NULL) OR (factory_commit IS NOT NULL))

missions_approved_fields_ck.name: missions_approved_fields_ck
missions_approved_fields_ck.value: ((approved_at IS NULL) OR ((plan_id IS NOT NULL) AND (package_key IS NOT NULL) AND (package_version IS NOT NULL) AND (price_micros IS NOT NULL) AND (deadline_at IS NOT NULL) AND (roster_version IS NOT NULL) AND (kb_release IS NOT NULL) AND (rules_version IS NOT NULL)))

missions_plan_state_ck.name: missions_plan_state_ck
missions_plan_state_ck.value: (((plan_id IS NULL) = (plan_state IS NULL)) AND ((plan_state IS NULL) OR (plan_state = 'approved'::text)))

missions_rendered_fields_ck.name: missions_rendered_fields_ck
missions_rendered_fields_ck.value: ((rendered_at IS NULL) OR ((approved_at IS NOT NULL) AND (branch_head IS NOT NULL)))

missions_pinned_commit_ck.name: missions_pinned_commit_ck
missions_pinned_commit_ck.value: ((approved_at IS NULL) OR (repo_connection_id IS NULL) OR (pinned_commit IS NOT NULL))

module_runs_parked_ck.name: module_runs_parked_ck
module_runs_parked_ck.value: (((state = 'parked'::text) = (parked_from IS NOT NULL)) AND ((parked_from IS NULL) OR (parked_from <> 'parked'::text)))

module_runs_started_ck.name: module_runs_started_ck
module_runs_started_ck.value:
(((started_at IS NULL) = (tests_base_commit IS NULL)) AND
CASE
    WHEN (COALESCE(parked_from, state) = 'blocked'::text) THEN (started_at IS NULL)
    ELSE (started_at IS NOT NULL)
END)

module_runs_build_base_ck.name: module_runs_build_base_ck
module_runs_build_base_ck.value:
CASE
    WHEN (COALESCE(parked_from, state) = ANY (ARRAY['blocked'::text, 'tests_writing'::text])) THEN (build_base_commit IS NULL)
    ELSE (build_base_commit IS NOT NULL)
END

module_runs_landed_triple_ck.name: module_runs_landed_triple_ck
module_runs_landed_triple_ck.value: (((landed_at IS NULL) = (landed_commit IS NULL)) AND ((landed_at IS NULL) = (current_commit IS NULL)))

module_runs_landed_ck.name: module_runs_landed_ck
module_runs_landed_ck.value: (((COALESCE(parked_from, state) <> ALL (ARRAY['landed'::text, 'reworking'::text])) OR (landed_at IS NOT NULL)) AND ((COALESCE(parked_from, state) <> ALL (ARRAY['blocked'::text, 'tests_writing'::text, 'tests_locked'::text, 'building'::text, 'retrying'::text, 'fixing'::text])) OR (landed_at IS NULL)))

proposals_resolved_ck.name: proposals_resolved_ck
proposals_resolved_ck.value: ((state = 'resolved'::text) = ((choice IS NOT NULL) AND (choice_reason IS NOT NULL) AND (resolved_by IS NOT NULL) AND (resolved_at IS NOT NULL)))

integration_commits_started_ck.name: integration_commits_started_ck
integration_commits_started_ck.value: ((state = 'queued'::text) OR ((base_sha IS NOT NULL) AND (started_at IS NOT NULL)))

integration_commits_finished_ck.name: integration_commits_finished_ck
integration_commits_finished_ck.value: ((state <> ALL (ARRAY['landed'::text, 'rejected'::text])) OR ((results IS NOT NULL) AND (finished_at IS NOT NULL)))

integration_commits_by_kind_ck.name: integration_commits_by_kind_ck
integration_commits_by_kind_ck.value:
CASE kind
    WHEN 'module'::text THEN ((module_run_id IS NOT NULL) AND (attempt_id IS NOT NULL))
    WHEN 'tests'::text THEN (module_run_id IS NOT NULL)
    WHEN 'dependency'::text THEN (dependency_request_id IS NOT NULL)
    WHEN 'operator'::text THEN ((module_run_id IS NULL) AND (attempt_id IS NULL) AND (dependency_request_id IS NULL))
    WHEN 'ui_contract'::text THEN (module_run_id IS NOT NULL)
    WHEN 'api_contract'::text THEN (module_run_id IS NOT NULL)
    WHEN 'dispatch_docs'::text THEN ((module_run_id IS NULL) AND (attempt_id IS NULL) AND (dependency_request_id IS NULL))
    ELSE NULL::boolean
END

credentials_parent_ck.name: credentials_parent_ck
credentials_parent_ck.value:
CASE
    WHEN (kind = 'service'::text) THEN ((dispatch_id IS NULL) AND (attempt_id IS NULL))
    ELSE ((dispatch_id IS NOT NULL) AND (attempt_id IS NOT NULL) AND (session_id IS NULL))
END

rooms_parent_ck.name: rooms_parent_ck
rooms_parent_ck.value:
CASE kind
    WHEN 'integration'::text THEN ((integration_commit_id IS NOT NULL) AND (dispatch_id IS NULL) AND (attempt_id IS NULL))
    WHEN 'image_build'::text THEN ((integration_commit_id IS NULL) AND (dispatch_id IS NULL) AND (attempt_id IS NULL))
    ELSE ((dispatch_id IS NOT NULL) AND (attempt_id IS NOT NULL) AND (integration_commit_id IS NULL))
END

budget_reservations_attempt_request_uq.name: budget_reservations_attempt_request_uq
budget_reservations_attempt_request_uq.where: ((request_id IS NOT NULL) AND (attempt_id IS NOT NULL))

budget_reservations_session_request_uq.name: budget_reservations_session_request_uq
budget_reservations_session_request_uq.where: ((request_id IS NOT NULL) AND (session_id IS NOT NULL))

budget_reservations_expected_ck.name: budget_reservations_expected_ck
budget_reservations_expected_ck.value: ((kind <> 'expected'::text) OR ((num_nonnulls(dispatch_id, session_id) = 1) AND (attempt_id IS NULL) AND (request_id IS NULL)))

budget_reservations_request_ck.name: budget_reservations_request_ck
budget_reservations_request_ck.value: ((kind <> 'request'::text) OR ((num_nonnulls(attempt_id, session_id) = 1) AND (request_id IS NOT NULL)))

budget_reservations_attempt_dispatch_ck.name: budget_reservations_attempt_dispatch_ck
budget_reservations_attempt_dispatch_ck.value: ((attempt_id IS NULL) OR (dispatch_id IS NOT NULL))

budget_reservations_settled_ck.name: budget_reservations_settled_ck
budget_reservations_settled_ck.value: (((state = 'settled'::text) = (settled_micros IS NOT NULL)) AND ((settled_micros IS NULL) OR (settled_micros <= reserved_micros)))

human_time_confirmed_ck.name: human_time_confirmed_ck
human_time_confirmed_ck.value: ((state <> 'confirmed'::text) OR ((ended_at IS NOT NULL) AND (minutes IS NOT NULL)))

check_results_subject_ck.name: check_results_subject_ck
check_results_subject_ck.value: ((scenario_key IS NOT NULL) OR (check_id IS NOT NULL))

gate_evaluations_parent_ck.name: gate_evaluations_parent_ck
gate_evaluations_parent_ck.value:
CASE gate
    WHEN 2 THEN ((integration_commit_id IS NOT NULL) AND (attempt_id IS NULL) AND (gate_run_id IS NULL))
    WHEN 3 THEN ((attempt_id IS NOT NULL) AND (integration_commit_id IS NULL) AND (gate_run_id IS NULL))
    WHEN 5 THEN ((gate_run_id IS NOT NULL) AND (integration_commit_id IS NULL) AND (attempt_id IS NULL))
    ELSE ((integration_commit_id IS NULL) AND (attempt_id IS NULL) AND (gate_run_id IS NULL))
END

deliveries_recorded_ck.name: deliveries_recorded_ck
deliveries_recorded_ck.value: ((state <> 'recorded'::text) OR ((recorded_at IS NOT NULL) AND (ref IS NOT NULL)))

secrets_material_ck.name: secrets_material_ck
secrets_material_ck.value: (((ciphertext IS NOT NULL) = (state = 'active'::text)) AND ((wrapped_dek IS NOT NULL) = (state = 'active'::text)))

rules_scope_parts_ck.name: rules_scope_parts_ck
rules_scope_parts_ck.value: (((scope = 'client'::text) = (client_id IS NOT NULL)) AND ((scope = 'stack'::text) = (stack IS NOT NULL)))

closeout_items_parent_ck.name: closeout_items_parent_ck
closeout_items_parent_ck.value:
CASE kind
    WHEN 'finding'::text THEN ((finding_id IS NOT NULL) AND (module_run_id IS NULL))
    WHEN 'lesson_candidate'::text THEN ((module_run_id IS NOT NULL) AND (finding_id IS NULL))
    ELSE NULL::boolean
END
